compilation_rationale: Compiled 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused-silica with air incidence. Initial thicknesses set to provided sequence with ±3% relative jitter implied for robust sampling. Targets enforce maximum mean transmittance in 1530–1565 nm and maximum mean reflectance in 400–700 nm at normal incidence. L-BFGS-B via adam_lbfgs with 3 starts. Relative uniform tolerance 3% encoded in uncertainty policy.
